personality: 6 Glass / Luxe structure with 7 Dark-First Utility typography and data emphasis
personality_one_liner: A cinematic, premium command center that feels like an expensive piece of technical hardware.

spacing.rule: Generous Apple-like margins, minimal chrome, sticky CTAs in thumb zone. Leave breathing room around dense data.

do's: Floating bottom tab bar over scrolling content
AI Review score cards layered over cinematic backgrounds
Ensure >= 75% dark tint behind text on glass for readability
dont's: Standard list rows without background imagery

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: A premium dashboard welcoming the user with their latest session stats and a quick entry into AI analysis.

states.loading: Dark skeleton loaders masking the hero card and recent sessions.
states.empty: Glass card prompting the user to 'Upload your first wave'.
states.error: Subtle red-tinted glass toast with a retry button.

screens.layout: Large hero section with 'dark_ocean_abstract' background and a glass-frosted overlay showing the latest session's overall score. A prominent 'Analyze Video' FAB or primary button sticky at bottom. Horizontal scroll for recent sessions below the hero.

screens.name: AI Review
screens.purpose: The core app experience breaking down a single wave with deep technical analysis and video playback.

states.loading: Skeleton UI over a dark background mimicking the layout of the score circles.
states.error: Error loading analysis message with reload CTA.

screens.layout: Top half is the video player (expo-video) with custom glass controls (slow-mo, frame-step). Below (scrollable): a large overall score ring (cyan). A 3-column grid of 12+ sub-score circles (brandTertiary bg, cyan progress rings). A 'Strengths' glass card. A 'Main Mistake' card (error color tinted). A numbered list of top 5 corrections. A scrollable horizontal row of pill-shaped 'Key Moments' timestamps that jump the video.

screens.name: Progress
screens.purpose: Tracks the surfer's evolution over time via high-contrast charts and metrics.

states.empty: Illustration of a wave with 'Complete analyses to see your trends'.

screens.layout: Large headline metric (e.g., 57/100 average) at the top. A line chart for score trends. A vertical list of 'Skill Evolution' bars showing +/- deltas (e.g., Rail Control +15%).

screens.name: Train
screens.purpose: A library of highly visual, actionable drills to improve specific weaknesses.
screens.layout: Horizontal category filters (Surf, Land, Balance, Mobility) pinned to top with glass effect. A 2-column grid of drill cards. Each card uses a photo with a bottom-heavy gradient scrim and text anchored at the bottom.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: Manages account settings, subscription tier, and preferences.
screens.layout: Top section features user level ('Ocean Explorer') inside a premium glass badge. Below are standard iOS-style settings rows grouped in surfaceSecondary rounded containers (Account, Quota, Language Picker).

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark premium theme (#0A0A0A background with #00E5FF cyan accents). Do not introduce navy or purple.
Implement glassmorphism using expo-blur on the bottom tab bar, floating headers, and the AI Review coach cards. Apply a >=75% opacity dark tint behind text over glass.
For the AI Review page, build a highly dense but readable data hierarchy using Rajdhani for the metrics and Satoshi for the subtext. 12+ sub-score circles should be compact (e.g., 3 columns).
Video player must be custom styled with slow-mo and frame-step controls overlaid on the video using glass effect.
Main Mistake card should distinctly utilize the `error` color token (#FF3366) as a subtle background tint (e.g., 10% opacity) to create contrast against the 'Strengths' cyan-tinted card.
All imagery with overlaid text (like Train tab drill cards) must include a top-to-bottom vertical linear gradient scrim (transparent to >=70% surfaceInverse).
Wire haptics heavily into the AI Review page (e.g., when tapping key moment timestamps, or adjusting video speed).
